hero.title: Run your classes. Know your students. Grow your club.
hero.subtitle: Lineup is the all-in-one management tool for coaches and clubs — sessions, contacts, bookings, and a student mobile app, all in one place.

features.title: Everything you need to run a modern club
features.subtitle: From solo coach to multi-location organisation, Lineup adapts to the way you work.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Schedule and track classes effortlessly. Set recurring sessions, manage attendance, and see your whole week at a glance in the calendar view.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Know every student. Profile pages, notes, activity history, and subscription status — everything you need to build lasting relationships.

mobile.title: Student mobile app
mobile.description: Students book sessions, check in, and stay connected on iOS and Android. No more WhatsApp chaos.

plans.title: Simple, transparent pricing
plans.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you're ready. No hidden fees.

coach.name: Coach
